events.title: Millersville University Dance Team Kids Camp
events.location: Student Memorial Center Dance Studio, Millersville University
events.description: Youth dance camp for dancers ages 6-12 led by the Millersville University Dance Team. Campers take a class in the Student Memorial Center dance studio, get lunch and a camp t-shirt, then perform at halftime of the MU football game at Biemesderfer Stadium. $30 per dancer; register via the flyer.

events.title: Salvation Army Christmas Assistance Applications
events.location: Salvation Army Lancaster Corps, 131 S. Queen St, Lancaster
events.description: The Salvation Army Lancaster Corps' annual Christmas Assistance program offers toys for children 12 and under and food gift cards for families in need. Apply in person Nov 3 (9 AM-3 PM) or Nov 4 (1-6 PM) at the Lancaster Corps, or online Nov 5-22.

events.title: Trunk or Treat at John Herr's Village Market
events.location: John Herr's Village Market parking lot, 25 Manor Ave, Millersville
events.description: Community Trunk or Treat hosted by the Millersville Lioness Lions Club in the John Herr's Village Market parking lot. Candy and treats, games, face painting and food trucks, 6:30 to 8:00 PM.

events.title: Penn Manor Mini-THON Trunk or Treat
events.description: Candy, games, and a great night for all children K-6. Hosted by Penn Manor Mini-THON. Tom's Coffee and Kona Ice on site. Athletic parking lot behind the high school - park on the parking deck.

events.title: Cider Making at the Loft
events.location: The Loft Community Partnership, 100 E. Charlotte St, Millersville
events.description: Free, hands-on cider-making workshop at The Loft Community Partnership - learn the "old fashioned way" to press cider. Kids and adults welcome; just stop in, no registration needed.
